title: Software Entwickler:in mit Schwerpunkt GenAI
description:
Wer wir sind
Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen.

Was dich erwartet

Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines.

Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden.

Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln.
Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen.
Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends.

Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung.
Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

This Product Manager will serve as the connective tissue between the Voyager product line, the Growth team, internal Anduril stakeholders, and external customer requirements. This role is responsible for owning product direction input and ensuring effective communications across all stakeholders-irrespective of whether the products are first party or third party delivered. While closely collaborating with the First Party team, this position will ensure that product decisions reflect both market intelligence and internal operational needs.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

1. Voyager Product Voice & Input

• Customer & Internal Feedback: Translate field feedback, customer intelligence, internal demand signals, and operational pain points into actionable product insights.

• Structured Feedback Loop: Establish regular channels to gather input from internal hardware recipients (e.g., Air Defense, Mission Command, Maritime) and relay it to Voyager product leadership.

• Product Prioritization: Collaborate with stakeholders to drive alignment on product priorities, including roadmap visibility, EOL planning, and new features (e.g., GPU upgrades, VM4 successors).

• Representation: Attend and contribute to Voyager product reviews and planning sessions, ensuring every voice-from internal teams to customer-facing groups-is considered.

2. Growth Team Integration

• Growth Bridge: Act as the primary liaison between the Growth team and the Voyager product line to ensure that external, customer-facing data enhances product decisions.

Build off the work Division Operations has already done here (ie Growth Product Roundtables) as well as the weekly Voyager NPI Sales meetings.

• Upcoming Product Rollouts: Ensure that the Growth team is well-informed of upcoming Voyager product decisions, enabling proactive customer communications.

3. Internal Communications Leadership

• Product Communication: Own and manage Anduril-internal communications regarding Voyager product updates, changes, and decisions.

• Central Information Hub: Maintain and evolve the Voyager channel to serve as the source of truth for product announcements, updates, and strategic insights.

• Regular Updates: Produce periodic updates that detail product changes to keep all relevant teams informed.

4. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

• Relationship Management: Strengthen relationships between Voyager teams (including Dublin counterparts), US-based teams, and external partners.

• Issue Escalation: Collaborate with the Product Operations team to raise challenges related to quality, and work with Supply Chain to raise issues related to delivery timelines.

• Operational Alignment: Collaborate with supply chain, demand planning, and manufacturing teams to ensure product decisions are smoothly integrated into operational processes.

5. Division Operations Continuity

• Collaborative Support: Continue supporting broader operational goals, including demand planning, hardware/software integration, and internal partnership development.

title: SEO Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About the Job
We're looking for an SEO Manager to get hands-on with our affiliate portfolio and grow it. You'll work directly with some of the biggest publishers in the world, and your work will show up in the numbers - fast.
You'll work across two areas: driving more revenue out of affiliate sites that are already live, and helping take brand-new sites from a blank page to go-live - keyword clustering, content structure, stakeholder coordination, the whole build. Every Google update, every new market, every publisher conversation is something you'll get your hands on.
At WLX, SEO isn't a support function - it's a driving force. We have the resources, the management backing, and the hands-on expertise to make things happen. And unlike an agency, everything we build is ours: our own projects, run in close collaboration with the world's biggest publishers. That means real ownership, real impact, and no client briefs.
This is what you'll do

• Drive revenue growth on existing affiliate sites: Develop and implement long-term SEO strategies, and own the on-page and off-page work that moves the needle.

• Improve and maintain rankings on key money pages: Run content audits, apply intent mapping, and improve CTR and SERP feature capture on your highest-value pages.

• Lead backlink campaigns: Build and execute link-building strategies across multiple affiliate sites, working with agencies, forums, and outreach partners to strengthen domain authority.

• Help take new affiliate sites live: Own keyword clustering, topic mapping, and content structure based on market and competitor research, and coordinate with stakeholders to get new sites launched from scratch.

• React fast when the landscape shifts: Assess the impact of Google algorithm updates, figure out what happened and why, and put a clear plan in place to recover traffic - without getting stuck in the noise.

This is what you’ve got

• Extensive SEO experience, with strong, hands-on expertise in both on-page and off-page work, and a track record of driving organic growth at scale.

• Fluent in German and English, confident in operating with stakeholders in both languages.

• Strong analytical thinking and prioritisation skills - you know what moves the needle and can back your decisions with data.

• Proactive and self-motivated, comfortable owning your workstream without needing to be told what's next.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, flat, startup-style environment.

• Experience in iGaming or other affiliate marketing industries is a plus.

At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

They excel at partnering cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other teams to transform complex sigånals and methodologies into credible, actionable, privacy-durable, and scalable products.

• Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for products that apply Pinterest’s identity, conversion, and measurement signals to improve advertiser outcomes across new-customer acquisition, incrementality, and bidding optimization.

• Partner closely with engineering, data science, design, research, PMM, sales, partnerships, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity to deliver solutions with strong product-market fit, methodological rigor, regulatory compliance, and long-term durability.

• Build a comprehensive suite of products that helps drive incremental reach and performance for Pinterest advertisers.

title: Senior Software Architect, AI Networking
description:
An applied research team within NVIDIA ’s Networking Systems & Software Architecture group is solving some of AI’s hardest infrastructure problems. The team builds systems-level software that moves data between GPUs, nodes, and storage at the speed modern AI demands-spanning low-level transport optimization, hardware-software co-design, and communication frameworks that plug directly into production AI stacks. The team's charter expands into emerging domains including quantum computing interconnects.
The Senior Architect role is to own modules and projects end-to-end-from scoping research questions to shipping production code. It calls for a recognized expert who drives technical decisions, pulls in ideas from research and industry, and regularly prototypes new approaches to prove a point. The work lives at the boundary of applied research and production engineering!
What you will be doing:

• Architecting and implementing high-performance communication and memory management libraries for distributed AI

• Driving hardware-software co-optimization with GPU, DPU, NIC, and switch teams through GPUDirect RDMA, NVLink, and next-generation interconnects

• Profiling and optimizing data movement across GPU memory, system DRAM, NVMe, and network fabrics

• Integrating networking capabilities into AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM

• Contributing to and maintaining open-source projects, mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and prototyping experimental technologies to evaluate their viability

What we need to see:

• 12+ years in systems software and/or networking with demonstrated ownership of complex projects.

• MS, PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Solid understanding of high-performance networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, NVLink, GPUDirect.

• Strong C/C++/Rust systems programming with comfort in performance profiling and low-level debugging.

• Understanding of ML systems concepts-transformer architectures, KV cache mechanics, model parallelism, or distributed training and inference patterns.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Knowledge of ML inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and their communication requirements.

• Knowledge of storage networking (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage, S3).

• Background of Reinforcement Learning systems.

With competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely regarded as one of the most desirable technology employers in the world. Our teams are composed of some of the most forward‑thinking and driven engineers in the industry, and we continue to grow rapidly. If you are a senior data engineer passionate about building large‑scale, high‑impact data platforms, we’d love to hear from you.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 2, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

title: Director, Organic Growth & Discovery
description:
Who is Credible ?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance - all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:
Credible is seeking an analytical, product-minded leader to own how consumers discover Credible online. The way people find financial products is evolving at a rapid pace. Search is turning into AI answers, and the decision to compare a loan or an insurance policy is moving beyond Google to AI platforms, Reddit, YouTube, or TikTok. We are uniquely positioned to be the trusted answer wherever that search begins.
In this role, you will own and scale organic discovery across Credible .com and our tier-1 publishing partners. SEO is the foundation but; the role spans everything SEO is becoming: traditional search, AI answer engines, and social and community platforms. You will also own the performance of the pages that organic traffic lands on, turning visits into completed applications through rigorous conversion rate optimization.
This is a highly visible role, both inside Credible and across our publisher partner network. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Editorial, Partnerships, and Paid Marketing, while leading a team of SEO and content specialists. The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, thinks like a product manager, and is grounded in revenue-based decisions. They can explain in dollars what happened, why it happened, and what we’re doing about it. You will thrive in a fast-moving environment and are passionate about helping consumers make great financial decisions.
Key Responsibilities:

• Own and lead Credible ’s organic discovery strategy across Credible .com and our tier-1 publishing partners, spanning SEO, AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), and social and community platforms (Reddit, YouTube, TikTok).

• Win visibility in AI-generated answers by understanding how large language models retrieve, summarize, and cite content, making our pages and product data easy to use and cite, and building presence in the off-site sources those models draw on, including forums, publishers, and earned media.

• Lead technical SEO at scale, including crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and schema, partnering closely with our Content Platform engineering team.

• Own conversion rate optimization for organic entry pages: set page and template requirements, build and run a disciplined A/B testing program, and partner with Product to improve the journey from first visit to completed application.

• Act as a product owner for organic experiences, writing clear requirements, prioritizing a roadmap with Product and Engineering, and shipping improvements that move both traffic and conversion.

• Bring analytical rigor to every decision: separate competitive non-brand traffic from brand and direct demand, tie organic performance to revenue, and diagnose changes in performance down to the query, page, and funnel stage.

• Establish clear measurement frameworks that track leading indicators and long-term outcomes, including rankings, AI citations and share of voice, conversion rate, and revenue per visit.

• Reporting to leadership and stakeholders, with clear communication on KPIs, initiatives, and overall portfolio performance.

• Build authority through digital PR, expert contributors, and partner content

title: Lead & Senior Data Engineers
description:
Lead & Senior Data Engineers
Location: Remote United States (US work authorization required)
Job Type: Multi-month engagement, likely to extend
Openings: 4 positions, 2 Lead and 2 Senior
Start Date: Around December 1, 2026
About Virtasant
Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.
Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.
About the Role
We are building a team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform pulls data from the many systems a hospital runs on, maps it into a shared ontology and knowledge graph, and uses it to help executives make operational decisions, act on them and measure the results.
The hardest recurring problem is getting messy enterprise data in, clean and trusted, for every new customer. You will build that: connectors and pipelines from HR, scheduling, EHR and external benchmark sources into Snowflake on Azure, mapped to the ontology and published to a Neo4j graph. You will make it repeatable, so the next customer’s data goes live in days, not months. You will work with real, sensitive client data, and you will use AI-assisted development as a normal part of how you build.
Lead vs Senior
Both levels are hands-on and write production code every week.
Lead: Owns the technical direction of a pod: its design, its standards and the order in which work gets done. Works directly with the client’s architects and data owners to agree source extracts, data contracts and acceptance criteria. Reviews other engineers’ code and designs, and is accountable for what the pod ships. You have led a small team of engineers, set technical direction and worked directly with client architects and stakeholders.
Senior: Owns significant pieces end to end, such as a source connector, a set of mappings or the reconciliation for a domain, inside the direction the Lead sets. Works independently, raises problems early and needs no day-to-day supervision.
What We're Looking For

• You have integrated messy enterprise source systems in production, not just clean APIs. You can talk through two or three: what the source really looked like, how you handled late files, schema drift, duplicates and conflicting records, and what you would do differently.

• Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on Snowflake. You have built and run layered pipelines (raw, cleaned, modelled) with dbt or equivalent, with mappings and rules kept as versioned code.

• Data contracts and versioned schemas. You define what a source must send, validate it on arrival, quarantine what fails and evolve schemas without breaking what sits downstream.

• Data quality, lineage and reconciliation as part of the build. You can prove that totals match the source, trace any number back to the record it came from, and rerun a load without duplicating data.

• Regulated or sensitive data. You have worked under PHI/PII controls such as HIPAA: masking and tokenisation, least-privilege access, audit trails and keeping sensitive fields out of places they should not be.

• Multi-tenant data platforms with strict per-customer isolation. You have built onboarding that is repeatable: a new customer is configuration and mapping, not a new code base.

• Azure experience: storage, identity and infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).

• AI-assisted development. You use coding assistants daily and check what they produce.

• You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.

• Available around December 1, 2026.

Strong Plus

• Healthcare data: HR and workforce systems such as Workday or UKG, s

title: Head of Data (Antwerp)
description:
Own Conveo's data, from the warehouse to the dashboard, and build the team every part of the business relies on.

This role can be based from either our London or Antwerp location.

Conveo is building the AI-powered infrastructure for consumer understanding, making consumer and B2B research fast, affordable and high quality. Global brands such as Unilever, Google and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across their marketing, product and research teams.

Backed by Y Combinator, we're in a period of rapid growth. We started this year with around 20 people and are on track to reach around 120 by year end, so the people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how the company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We’re investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

THE ROLE

You'll be our first Head of Data. You'll own internal data at Conveo and build the team that serves the whole company with it.

You won't be starting from a blank page. Our GTM engineering team has built a data warehouse and semantic layer and has made a start on BI, and colleagues in operations have helped shape our metric definitions. What we don't have is one person who owns all of it, knows what good looks like, and turns it into something every team trusts and uses.

You'll report to our CFO and work very closely with our CTO, as well as with the engineering team, operations and go-to-market. This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the data yourself, not writing a strategy and handing it over. You'll start as the first member of the data team, with a remit to hire as we grow.

This is a role for the long term, not an audit-and-leave project. It starts with the foundations and grows into a bigger team, with room for machine learning and data science to help us predict more across the business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the data stack end to end

- Take ownership of our warehouse (Google BigQuery), our transformation and semantic layers (dbt and Cube today) and our BI tooling (Metabase today)

- Review what's been built with a critical eye, and get it ready to scale as new tools and data sources come in

- Think through access rights, so it's clear who can see customer, HR and financial data once it all lives in one place

Build one source of truth the business trusts

- Own metric definitions, so every team works from the same numbers

- Close the gaps that matter most, starting with areas like marketing attribution and the data our finance team needs for its analysis

- Make our data reliable enough that people trust it and act on it

Turn data into insight for every team

- Sit down with department leads, get to the real question behind a request, and build the analysis that answers it

- Act as the translator between engineering and the business: ask engineers the hard questions about what to build, and explain data in plain English to everyone else

- Swap today's sprawl of one-off dashboards and AI-generated reports for a clear set of things people actually need to look at

Use AI well, without the slop

- Shape our data so AI tools can use it reliably

- Help the business get real value from AI for analysis, without a flood of low-quality output

Build the data team

- Hire your first team members, and set out what the BI team should look like as we grow

- Lay the groundwork for machine learning and data science later on

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- After one month: you know our data infrastructure properly and have run a full gap analysis covering what we take in, what we understand and what's missing. You also have a plan for what to fix first and a plan for the team, including your first hires.

title: Operational Buyer and Planner
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The Role

Sunrise Robotics is hiring an Operational Buyer and Planner to make sure every robotic cell has the right parts, on time, at the right stock level. We buy all components in house and our manufacturing partners assemble the cells, so one missing part at a partner stops a build. This role runs purchasing, expediting, stock and build planning every day, for series production and for our R&D lab.

You will turn the build plan into component orders, follow every order until it reaches the manufacturing partner, and act early when a delivery is at risk. As the daily contact for our suppliers and manufacturing partners, you will also keep Odoo data accurate enough that the whole company can plan on it. Much of this work is repetitive and data heavy, from matching delivery notes to purchase orders to building reports from Odoo exports, so we expect you to use AI tools as a normal part of it and to remove manual steps wherever you find them.

In your first 6 months, you will run purchasing and stock for all cell builds and lab orders. By month 12, reorder points will run in Odoo and key suppliers will have logistics agreements in place.

What You’ll Do

- Plan the weekly build schedule with Supply Chain and book assembly slots with our manufacturing partners.

- Buy components for series production and indirect items for our R&D lab, from purchase order to receipt.

- Expedite critical orders, check deliveries and delivery notes, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers.

- Manage stock, reorder points and safety stock as requested by Supply Chain.

- Organise transport of components to our manufacturing partners, prepare import dispositions for forwarders, handle customs clearance, and prepare logistics agreements with suppliers.

- Maintain component master data in Odoo (prices, MOQs, packaging units, lead times) and help prepare it for MRP.

- Report on-time delivery, orders closed on time and stock levels every week, and raise anything that is off plan at the daily production meeting, so nothing stops.

- Use AI tools to speed up the recurring work in this role, such as reconciling deliveries, drafting supplier communication and building reports, and replace manual steps in the purchasing and planning routine where you can.

What You’ll Need

- 3+ years in operational purchasing or production planning in a manufacturing company.

- Daily, hands-on work in an ERP system (purchasing, inventory, production), a working understanding of MRP, and advanced Excel.

- Experience managing suppliers on delivery dates and resolving delivery issues.

- Accuracy with master data and numbers: you notice when a lead time, a quantity or a BOM line is wrong before you order on it.

- Clear written and spoken communication with component suppliers, manufacturing partners and colleagues in engineering and quality.

- A track record of taking over an area of work and running it independently.

- Fluent written and spoken Slovenian and English.

What Makes You Stand Out

- Experience with Odoo.

- Experience in make-to-order or high-mix, low-volume manufacturin

title: Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant
description:
Company Overview A professional in global philanthropy has spent the last four years sourcing, vetting, and running due diligence on nonprofits around the world, selecting organisations that then go on to raise funding. Having recently moved from a full-time role into consulting for the same organisation, they are now building an independent consulting practice working with nonprofits and donors. Alongside this, they are growing an investing practice focused on sourcing and researching new deals.

Role Overview Seeking a highly organised, proactive Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant to take ownership of the founder's inbox, calendar, follow-ups, and day-to-day admin across both consulting work and personal life. During this transition into running an independent practice, the role requires someone who can help build the systems behind it (CRM, sales pipeline, scheduling, follow-up routines) so that everything is clean and in place going forward. The goal is to free up the executive's time to focus on consulting and investing. This role starts part-time and is expected to grow into a full-time position.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and triage a very high-volume Gmail inbox: sort, prioritise, archive, flag what needs attention, and draft or send replies.

• Own the Google Calendar across multiple time zones, including meetings, client and prospect interviews, and travel.

• Track to-dos and follow-ups, and send proactive reminders and nudges so nothing slips through the cracks.

• Communicate with contacts mostly as a third party (scheduling, coordination) and, where agreed, draft or send replies on the executive's behalf.

• Help set up the infrastructure for the new consulting practice: CRM, sales pipeline, follow-up tracking, and potential-client interview scheduling.

• Research CRM options (having previously used Affinity and currently testing alternatives), then present the best options with pros and cons for a final decision. Start with a Google Sheets tracker in the meantime if needed.

• Handle personal admin, including booking appointments and chasing insurance companies and service providers until issues are resolved.

• Coordinate frequent international travel: flights, accommodation, itineraries, and calendar updates across time zones.

• Support research tasks, including first-pass research on nonprofits, potential consulting clients, and new investment opportunities.

• Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up admin, and help set up simple recurring workflows and automations.

Skills & Tools

• 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Personal Assistant, ideally supporting a founder, consultant, or busy executive.

• Strong Google Workspace skills (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs).

• Experience with at least one CRM (e.g., Affinity, HubSpot, Attio, Pipedrive) and building a simple pipeline from scratch.

• Excellent written English. Confident drafting emails in an executive’s voice and following up persistently but politely.

• Very organised and proactive. Comfortable in a startup-style setup where processes are still being built and can change quickly.

• Calm, structured, and reliable. Able to keep a busy executive on track without needing to be chased.

• Strong research skills, with the ability to summarise options clearly and make a recommendation.

• Nice to have: hands-on experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and automations; any experience building AI agents is a bonus.

• Nice to have: exposure to nonprofit, philanthropy, consulting, or investment/VC environments.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

- Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

- Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

- Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

- Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Senior Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram
